dedupe_keys.name: data set on district heating potentials in eu 27 countries

description: This data set holds the input and output data of an assessment of district heating potential in the 27 EU countries under evolving district heating market shares and an ambitious heat demand reduction scenario. It was published by Mostafa Fallahnejad to document and share that assessment. Inputs draw on the Best-Case scenario of the European Commission report on renewable space heating under the revised Renewable Energy Directive (Kranzl and co-authors, 2022) and on the BL2050 scenario of the sEEnergies project spatial models (Möller and co-authors, 2022), and outputs give the resulting district heating potentials. Coverage is the EU-27. The data come as one ZIP archive of about 5.1 GB on Zenodo (December 2022) under CC-BY-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the potentials depend on the two source scenarios and the assessment method, the record page gives little detail on file structure, and the archive is large. Simulation uses are strategic heat planning and district heating expansion studies at European scale. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
